arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ حم
transliteration: Hameem
translation: Ha. Mim

arabic: وَالكِتٰبِ المُبينِ
transliteration: Waalkitabi almubeeni
translation: By the Scripture that maketh plain

arabic: إِنّا أَنزَلنٰهُ فى لَيلَةٍ مُبٰرَكَةٍ إِنّا كُنّا مُنذِرينَ
transliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena
translation: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning

arabic: فيها يُفرَقُ كُلُّ أَمرٍ حَكيمٍ
transliteration: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin
translation: Whereon every wise command is made clear

arabic: أَمرًا مِن عِندِنا إِنّا كُنّا مُرسِلينَ
transliteration: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena
translation: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending

arabic: رَحمَةً مِن رَبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّميعُ العَليمُ
transliteration: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
translation: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower

arabic: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما إِن كُنتُم موقِنينَ
transliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure

arabic: لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ يُحيۦ وَيُميتُ رَبُّكُم وَرَبُّ ءابائِكُمُ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena
translation: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

arabic: بَل هُم فى شَكٍّ يَلعَبونَ
transliteration: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona
translation: Nay, but they play in doubt

arabic: فَارتَقِب يَومَ تَأتِى السَّماءُ بِدُخانٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin
translation: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

arabic: يَغشَى النّاسَ هٰذا عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
transliteration: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun
translation: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment

arabic: رَبَّنَا اكشِف عَنَّا العَذابَ إِنّا مُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona
translation: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers

arabic: أَنّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكرىٰ وَقَد جاءَهُم رَسولٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun
translation: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them

arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوا عَنهُ وَقالوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَجنونٌ
transliteration: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun
translation: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman

arabic: إِنّا كاشِفُوا العَذابِ قَليلًا إِنَّكُم عائِدونَ
transliteration: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona
translation: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief)

arabic: يَومَ نَبطِشُ البَطشَةَ الكُبرىٰ إِنّا مُنتَقِمونَ
transliteration: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona
translation: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish

arabic: وَلَقَد فَتَنّا قَبلَهُم قَومَ فِرعَونَ وَجاءَهُم رَسولٌ كَريمٌ
transliteration: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun
translation: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger

arabic: أَن أَدّوا إِلَىَّ عِبادَ اللَّهِ إِنّى لَكُم رَسولٌ أَمينٌ
transliteration: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
translation: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

arabic: وَأَن لا تَعلوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنّى ءاتيكُم بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin
translation: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant

arabic: وَإِنّى عُذتُ بِرَبّى وَرَبِّكُم أَن تَرجُمونِ
transliteration: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni
translation: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death

arabic: وَإِن لَم تُؤمِنوا لى فَاعتَزِلونِ
transliteration: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni
translation: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go

arabic: فَدَعا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ قَومٌ مُجرِمونَ
transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona
translation: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk

arabic: فَأَسرِ بِعِبادى لَيلًا إِنَّكُم مُتَّبَعونَ
transliteration: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona
translation: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed

arabic: وَاترُكِ البَحرَ رَهوًا إِنَّهُم جُندٌ مُغرَقونَ
transliteration: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona
translation: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host

arabic: كَم تَرَكوا مِن جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
transliteration: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin
translation: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind

arabic: وَزُروعٍ وَمَقامٍ كَريمٍ
transliteration: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin
translation: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

arabic: وَنَعمَةٍ كانوا فيها فٰكِهينَ
transliteration: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena
translation: And pleasant things wherein they took delight

arabic: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَورَثنٰها قَومًا ءاخَرينَ
transliteration: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena
translation: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk

arabic: فَما بَكَت عَلَيهِمُ السَّماءُ وَالأَرضُ وَما كانوا مُنظَرينَ
transliteration: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena
translation: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

arabic: وَلَقَد نَجَّينا بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ مِنَ العَذابِ المُهينِ
transliteration: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni
translation: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom

arabic: مِن فِرعَونَ إِنَّهُ كانَ عالِيًا مِنَ المُسرِفينَ
transliteration: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena
translation: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones

arabic: وَلَقَدِ اختَرنٰهُم عَلىٰ عِلمٍ عَلَى العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena
translation: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures

arabic: وَءاتَينٰهُم مِنَ الءايٰتِ ما فيهِ بَلٰؤٌا۟ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun
translation: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial

arabic: إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ لَيَقولونَ
transliteration: Inna haolai layaqooloona
translation: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying

arabic: إِن هِىَ إِلّا مَوتَتُنَا الأولىٰ وَما نَحنُ بِمُنشَرينَ
transliteration: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena
translation: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again

arabic: فَأتوا بِـٔابائِنا إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
translation: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth

arabic: أَهُم خَيرٌ أَم قَومُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم أَهلَكنٰهُم إِنَّهُم كانوا مُجرِمينَ
transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena
translation: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty

arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما لٰعِبينَ
transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
translation: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play

arabic: ما خَلَقنٰهُما إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
translation: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not

arabic: إِنَّ يَومَ الفَصلِ ميقٰتُهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena
translation: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them

arabic: يَومَ لا يُغنى مَولًى عَن مَولًى شَيـًٔا وَلا هُم يُنصَرونَ
transliteration: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona
translation: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped

arabic: إِلّا مَن رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ العَزيزُ الرَّحيمُ
transliteration: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
translation: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful

arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقّومِ
transliteration: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi
translation: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum

arabic: طَعامُ الأَثيمِ
transliteration: TaAAamu alatheemi
translation: The food of the sinner

arabic: كَالمُهلِ يَغلى فِى البُطونِ
transliteration: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni
translation: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

arabic: كَغَلىِ الحَميمِ
transliteration: Kaghalyi alhameemi
translation: As the seething of boiling water

arabic: خُذوهُ فَاعتِلوهُ إِلىٰ سَواءِ الجَحيمِ
transliteration: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi
translation: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell

arabic: ثُمَّ صُبّوا فَوقَ رَأسِهِ مِن عَذابِ الحَميمِ
transliteration: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi
translation: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water

arabic: ذُق إِنَّكَ أَنتَ العَزيزُ الكَريمُ
transliteration: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu
translation: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا ما كُنتُم بِهِ تَمتَرونَ
transliteration: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona
translation: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt

arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى مَقامٍ أَمينٍ
transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin
translation: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured

arabic: فى جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
transliteration: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
translation: Amid gardens and watersprings

arabic: يَلبَسونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِستَبرَقٍ مُتَقٰبِلينَ
transliteration: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena
translation: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another

arabic: كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجنٰهُم بِحورٍ عينٍ
transliteration: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
translation: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

arabic: يَدعونَ فيها بِكُلِّ فٰكِهَةٍ ءامِنينَ
transliteration: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena
translation: They call therein for every fruit in safety

arabic: لا يَذوقونَ فيهَا المَوتَ إِلَّا المَوتَةَ الأولىٰ وَوَقىٰهُم عَذابَ الجَحيمِ
transliteration: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi
translation: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell

arabic: فَضلًا مِن رَبِّكَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ
transliteration: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
translation: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph

arabic: فَإِنَّما يَسَّرنٰهُ بِلِسانِكَ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَذَكَّرونَ
transliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
translation: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed

arabic: فَارتَقِب إِنَّهُم مُرتَقِبونَ
transliteration: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona
translation: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting
